I built my ultimate desk setup with the Desktronic HomeMax! In this video, I'm assembling the desk and SitPro office chair, organising all the cables, and testing two different setups: two monitors versus one mounted on a monitor arm.

The HomeMax features a beautiful American walnut tabletop, a four-motor height adjustment system, an integrated touchscreen, LED lighting, and USB-C charging. I also customised my setup with accessories, including navy blue wheels for the SitPro chair.

Which setup do you prefer: two monitors or one? Let me know in the comments!
